Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F00960225
Sheriff’s File # 26000296
PLAINTIFF – Melissa Abbruscato a/k/a Melissa Medina, vs:
DEFENDANTS- Daniel Abbruscato
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 14th day of September 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Lake Como, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 40, Qualifier C0300, Block 10 Tax Map of Borough of Lake Como
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
1606 Main Street #F300 U1 B3, Lake Como, NJ 07719
Nearest Cross Street: 16th Avenue
Approximate Dimensions: As Property is Condominium, no approximate dimensions available.
Pursuant to a municipal tax search dated July 27, 2026, subject to:
TAXES: 2025 Real Property taxes $3,700.39 paid in Full
1st Quarter 2026 Real Property Taxes due 2/1/26 in an amount of $925.10 Paid.
2nd Quarter 2026 Real Property Taxes due 5/1/26 in an amount of $925.10 Paid.
3rd Quarter 2026 Real Property Taxes due 8/1/26 Taxes Remain to be Determined.
4th Quarter 2026 Real Property Taxes due 11/1/26 Taxes Remain to be Determined.
Added Assessments: No bill as of 7/15/26; verify with owner that no taxable improvements have been made that may result in an omitted/added assessment billing in October for 2024/2025/2026 additional taxes due.
Water: Account 328-0 To: 6/30/26 $769.78 Open + Penalty
Account 328-0 7/1/26-6/30/27 $213.65 Open + Penalty; 213.65 Open + Due Each 10/1/2026, 1/1/2027 & 4/1/2027
Bill based on consumption through 5/5/26.
Subject to Final Reading. Billed Annually: contact 732-681-3232
Mail Payments to: Borough of Lake Como, 1740 Main Street, Lake Como, NJ 07719-0569
Sewer: Account 328-0 To: 6/30/26 $544.50 Open + Penalty
Account 328-0 7/1/26 - 6/30/27 $157.65 Open + Penalty
157.65 Open + Due Each 10/1/2026, 1/1/2027 & 4/1/2027
Bill based on consumption through 4/28/25; Subject to Final Reading, Billed Annually; contact 732-681-3232
Mail Payments to: Borough of Lake Como, 1740 Main Street, Lake Como, NJ 07719-0569
Property being sold subject to the Following First Mortgage: First Mortgage made by Daniel Abbruscato to Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., dated May 14, 2020, recorded May 21, 2020, in Mortgage Book 9415, Page 4553, et. seq. to secure the original principal sum of $159,375.00, with total balance outstanding through June 20,2026 in the approximate amount of $132,925.78.
Property Also Being Sold Subject to Any and All Condominium Liens and Assessments.
Approximate Good Faith Estimate of Upset Price: $141,810.59. The upset amount may be subject to further Orders for Additional Sums.
Current Occupancy Status: Owner Occupied
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $138,255.28.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: July 30, 2026
Buchanan, Ingersoll & Rooney, P.C.
attn: Thomas W. Halm Jr.
210 Carnegie Center, Suite 102
Princeton, NJ 08540
